conclusion: Most masks visibly follow a real single calf body, with substantially different box extent from publisher annotations. No obvious empty-background names seen in these sheets. Two annotated-absent instances contain visible animals; four crowded/shifted cases remain ambiguous. This does not certify all biological identities, erase any of34strict errors, or justify changing annotations/thresholds after the result.
order: All six prediction-only sheets inspected before all six publisher-truth sheets. All34cases retained, no model calls or frame reselection.
reviewer: identity_evaluation agent; AI visual review, not human field certification
